Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de utilaje pentru automatizări
Siemens Smart Infrastructure combines the real and digital worlds across energy systems, buildings and industries, enhancing the way people live and work and significantly improving efficiency and sustainability.
We work together with customers and partners to create an ecosystem that both intuitively responds to the needs of people and helps customers achieve their business goals. It helps our customers to thrive, communities to progress and supports sustainable development to protect our planet for the next generation.
Within our buildings business, our diverse global team will support you through your career and challenge you to grow in new and exciting ways as we transform the world’s infrastructure.
We continue developing our cloud technology and offer our own Edge Device as central access point based on embedded Linux.
We are looking for technically strong software engineer to contribute to the team's work starting with the UI (Angular) and later Golang/Rust components.
Your job – challenging and future oriented
 Develop components for the next generation cloud centric IoT based building automation system to improve building energy efficiency with strong focus to ease of use.
 Full-stack Developer contributing to different software components.
 Use DevOps practices to ensure high-quality deliveries including CI/CD with automated test.
 Drive technical quality through clear documentation, issue analysis, bug fixing, and effective source code management.
 Develop features for our existing platform using programming languages such as TypeScript (Angular) for UI and Golang / Rust for backend components.
 Interact daily with team members in a multi-cultural international setup ensuring smooth progress, raising issues and solving them together.
 Nice to have experience in AWS cloud services and technologies.
 Optionally good know-how of C++.
 Your Qualifications – Solid And Appropriate
 An academic degree in Information Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunication or a related field.
 Solid experience in professional software development environment ideally for UI with TypeScript and Angular, HTML5 and backend services.
 Experience in software development for backend components
 Nice to have: experience with Go Lang or Rust
 Knowledge on cloud native software development tools like containerization (Docker or Podman), inner source (Gitlab or GitHub), AWS including cloud security.
 You have a passion for software craftsmanship with an agile mindset.
 Good social skills when it comes to work in global teams or present ideas and concepts to other stakeholders.
 Experience with Embedded Devices.
 Your English skills allow you to work effectively in an international team.
 Understanding of test automation and importance of the CI/CD.
